notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR23: for a file-name or cd-name reference DEBUG-LINE identifies the statement, DEBUG-NAME the name, "For READ, DEBUG-CONTENTS contains the entire record read", spaces for every other file reference, and the CD area for a cd-name. DebugTriggerPlanner.PlanFile tags READ fires FileRecord and the rest Spaces, PlanCd fires with the CD area; DebugTriggerEmitter.FireText renders the record area, "" or the CD image, LandFileNameAfterFailure forces spaces on a READ that read nothing, and DebugItem.PopulateReference sets the members. Probes at 85: indexed random and sequential READ NEXT show the record, OPEN/CLOSE/START/DELETE spaces, a failed READ (23, 10) spaces; a RECORD VARYING file shows the 300-char record then the 5-char one with spaces after; an output CD shows its area after DISABLE, ENABLE and SEND, and PURGE runs nothing (GR8); COBOL0902 at 2002/2023.
